messages:
mira: Heads-up — Procurement sent over a pilot quote from CloudMeterX for our cost observability POC. They propose a 3-month trial with a flat fee + consumption overage. Can finance/legal weigh in on negotiable items?

jon: Can you paste the numbers? Also need to know if the flat fee covers alerts/retention or if those are separate SKUs.

mira: Quote snippet:
```
Pilot Fee: $6,500/month (covers up to 25M tokens/day),
Overage: $0.00002/token,
Retention Add-on (90 days): $1,200/month,
Alerting & Integrations: separate one-time setup $1,000,
Auto-renew: rolls into annual term after pilot unless canceled 45 days prior.
```

tara: Flag: auto-enroll into annual is risky. We should insist on an explicit opt-in to renew or a month-to-month extension after pilot. Also request a spend cap during pilot so we don't accidentally hit overages during load tests. :exclamation: 

finance-bot: Note: any pilot >$5k/mo requires finance approval + PO. Suggest asking for a capped pilot amendment: set hard monthly max of $10k and 0% price increase during pilot.

oliver: From eng: alerting integration looks fine but we need to confirm whether token accounting is per-character or per-token and whether they normalize across models. Ask for sample billing CSV and meter mapping. If overage calc is opaque we won't be able to reconcile.

mira: I'll request billing sample and ask them to clarify tokenization logic. Also I'll push back on the auto-transition to annual. If they insist on a renewal path, propose: automatic renewal only if mutually agreed in writing 30 days prior and at the same rates.

legal-bot: Suggest these contract asks: 1) No automatic conversion to multi-year without explicit signed amendment; 2) Right to terminate pilot for convenience with 14 days' notice during trial; 3) Data deletion certification within 45 days of termination; 4) Audit rights limited to SOC2 or similar report (no intrusive audits).

jon: Can procurement also run a parallel quote from SpendPilot and LedgerLens? We should compare nominal unit price and the billing export formats. If CloudMeterX can provide a breakdown by route/model, that earns points.

mira: Will do. Action items: Mira to request billing CSV + tokenization docs and push for capped spend; Jon to open comparison RFP with SpendPilot + LedgerLens; Tara/legal to draft short redline for pilot terms. Hold off on PO until we have CSV and legal OK.

oliver: One more ask: request a sandbox where we can simulate a 2x spike for 48h and see billing delta. Helps validate overage math.

mira: Good call. I'll include that in the ask. Thanks all.
